finalResult.nextParagraphText: Miyamoto considered for a while before deciding. “Would you be a dear and show me where I may get in touch with the vampires belonging to the Order of the Malefic Viper? I believe it’s high time we have a discussion.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The Sword Saint stored away the last of the painting supplies he’d purchased, hoping they would tide him over for now.
